Proposition
[Nonlinear asymptotic stability estimate (Proposition 35.19)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0311, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0312 ↗ prop:chow-iv-linear-maximal-regularity 1. ch35:35.19\group Maximal Regularity

For $u'=F(u)$ with $F(0)=0$, sectorial linear part, $C^1$ nonlinearity, and locally Lipschitz derivative, there is $r>0$ such that $\| u_0\| _{\mathcal E_{1+\theta }}\le r$ gives a unique exponentially decaying solution \[ u\in C^1_\eta ([0,\infty );\mathcal E_\theta )\cap C_\eta ([0,\infty );\mathcal E_{1+\theta }). \]
